notes: «ح» splits two branches (Abu al-Rabi' and Sa'id); «قال انطلقنا إلى أنس بن مالك» is written once after the last «ح», so Anas is the shared tail
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss: left out
«تشفعنا بثابت» and the people in the scene (Thabit, al-Hasan) are not links; «قال حدثنا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم» ends at the Prophet
«فأشهد على الحسن أنه حدثنا به أنه سمع أنس» comes after the saying as a testimony about al-Hasan; it is not written as a route here
